title: Step-failure test vectors
description: Format of test-vectors/step-failures/cases.json (registry/step-failures.json, docs/installation-plan.md section 8). Each case names a platform, either a plan step kind or a bootstrap state whose work is not a plan step, and a failure class. expected=mapped: the class can occur there; the operation reports reason_code, moves to expected_next_state and emits an event of type expected_event. expected=not_applicable: the class cannot occur there, and an implementation never reports that failure with the class's reason code. classification_cases fix how the class is chosen from how a command ended (docs/installation-plan.md section 8.2): `command` is the kind of command, `result` how it ended, `expected` a failure class of that step kind or state, or `ok` (no failure), `answer` (the exit status of the probe is its answer; also an engine identity that could not be read while the service manager reports the daemon inactive: the daemon is stopped) or `evidence` (a complete, well-formed answer that is not the expected one).

command.description: download_source, client_action: the client actions of a step; client_file: the client writing its own copy of a file of the step (rootfs copy, verified copy on the host). engine_identity: reading the engine's identity (info and version). apt_update, apt_install: /usr/bin/apt-get update / install. program: any other program or install_file of a step. engine_pull: the pull of an image_pull step; engine: any other Docker Engine command; diagnostic: the wait for the diagnostic container. probe_output: a probe program whose answer is its output; probe_exit_status: a probe program whose answer is its exit status; host_query: a read of the host API that starts no process (registry, system information, files).

outcome.description: completed / failed: an action without a process of its own (for engine_identity: completed = the identity was read, given as `engine`). disk_full / storage_failed: the client could not write its own file because the system reported a full disk / for any other reason. not_started, timed_out, exited (with exit_status as the launcher reports it, a signed or unsigned 32-bit value on Windows): a process. request_error / stream_error: an Engine API request failed / the progress stream of an accepted pull reported an error. container_exited (with exit_status): the diagnostic container exited; wait_timed_out (with container): the wait reached the smoke-test timeout and an inspect showed the container `running`, or gave no answer (`unknown`).

output.description: For probe_output with exit status 0: expected (the expected answer), unexpected (complete and well-formed, but another answer), malformed (incomplete or not well-formed).

service_active.description: For engine_identity: the answer of `systemctl is-active docker.service`, when the case gives it. The identity is read before this answer is used (CR-82).

engine.description: For engine_identity: OperatingSystem of the engine's info answer and Platform.Name of its version answer.
